annotations.title: Validate a note on a Nexez booking

description: Dry-run adding a note to an appointment the buyer already booked. Needs the buyer's own booking link (the orderUrl returned when it was booked). Returns the note for the buyer to approve before using the returned handoff. Notes lock when the appointment starts. Never sends the note.

note.description: Plain-text note, up to 1,000 characters. No Social Security, card, bank or wiring details.

order.description: The buyer's booking link (orderUrl), exactly as returned when the appointment was booked.
